rows.filledValue: Black 2: block-table save, NOT sectors. Main save at addr 0, backup at 0x26000, each 0x26000 bytes. Footer magic 0x31053527, footer size 0x10 (count u32, size u32, magic u32, unkC u16, crc u16). Per block: footer with count u16 + crc u16. CRC-16-CCITT polynomial 0x1021 over each block and over the block-CRC table. Recovery: newer-copy CRCs tried first; per-block bad blocks recopied from the good copy; a block bad in both copies breaks the save. Box trays are main-save blocks 1..24; extra saves follow the two main copies (Hall of Fame alone has a backup).
rows.gen3Contrast: FireRed/LeafGreen sector shape (2 slots x 14 sectors x 3968 data + 128 footer = 4096) is a different generation's medium and is NOT the Black 2 answer; staged only so the old H7 wording is not mistaken for canonical.
